name: autoresearch
description: One-prompt agent autoresearch loop for StepCOVNet: goal + time budget → orient, hypothesize, run, log, repeat until success or deadline. Use when the user says "run autoresearch", gives a research goal with a budget, or names a profile (e.g. ar-tide-overfit). Not for unattended Python planners (--hours / lattice).

findings.excerpt: - WSL `pkg_resources` missing mid-session — fixed with `pip install setuptools` in `~/stepcovnet-venv-wsl`.
